units.source_text: 说是“家乡”，其实他并不是在这个地方出生。

en.t: Though it was called his "hometown," he had not actually been born in this place.
This was his mother's ancestral home.

units.source_text: 母亲在港市不当艺妓之后，就留在这里当了舞蹈师傅。

en.t: After his mother stopped working as a geisha in the port town, she stayed here and became a dance teacher.

units.source_text: 她还不到五十岁得了中风症，就回到这个温泉来疗养了。

en.t: Before she was even fifty, she suffered a stroke and returned to this hot spring to recuperate.

units.source_text: 他则自幼爱摆弄机器，特意留在这个港市，进了一家钟表店。

en.t: As for him, he had loved tinkering with machines since childhood, deliberately stayed in this port town, and went to work in a clock and watch shop.

units.source_text: 不久，好像到东京上夜校去了。

en.t: Before long, he apparently went to Tokyo to attend night school.

units.source_text: 也许是积劳成疾吧，今年才二十六岁。

en.t: Perhaps overwork had made him ill; he was only twenty-six this year.
